nudge.review: Build it yourself first — in your head, out loud, or in your notebook. Then reveal.
nudge.read: Read aloud — and jot anything new into your notebook.
nudge.produce: Write it in your notebook — the whole sentence, by hand, in the romanization. Then compare.
nudge.comprehend: Work out what it means — in your head, out loud, or in your notebook. Then compare.

ritual.constraint: One new sentence at this level — not one of these {sentenceCount} — in your notebook. Up to {maxWords} words, only words you’ve learned.

check.copy: Now check it yourself — ask someone who knows Arabic, or dig on the internet. Checking is your job, not the app’s.
check.resourcePerson: Anyone who knows Arabic — a friend, a colleague, family. Ask them; that’s the surest way.
check.resourceInternet: The internet, yourself — a dictionary, a search: whatever method feels right.
check.caption: No buttons in this step — deliberately. This work happens outside the app.

confirm.holdLabel: I wrote my {ordinal} sentence and checked it myself — press and hold

retry.title: Fresh sentences, once more.
retry.body: One answer came out different — that’s fine, that’s information. Take two fresh sentences and compare calmly.

pendingAuthoring: The sentences for this rung are still being written — they’ll land right here once someone who knows Arabic has checked them. Until then, practise the rungs behind you; the ladder isn’t going anywhere.

verdict.line: Your sentence, your Arabic — the app checked nothing and saved nothing. The next rung is open — {nextModule}.

switchToast: You’re on {to} now. Your {from} ladder is saved exactly where it was.
storageNote: What you wrote isn’t in here — the app never keeps it.
notebookInvitation: Your notebook is your workbook — nothing is written inside the app.
